GREAT Scholarships at the Example University

The Example University is offering GREAT Scholarships for the 2026-27 academic year, each worth £13,000.

Scholarships are available for students from:

  • India
  • Thailand

The scholarships are available for all full-time postgraduate taught master's programmes.

Why Example?

Marketing text that mentions a deadline for applications is 1 January 1999 but must be ignored.

Apply for a GREAT Scholarship at the Example University

To apply, visit the website. The deadline for applications is 24 April 2026, 5pm BST.
